name: YAMZ
description: YAMZ (Yet Another Media Zombie) is a good-looking browser for your movie and TV collection. Connect Plex or Jellyfin and get a poster wall with ratings, cast and photos, a Gaps page that finds what's missing from your franchises and TV seasons, Discover (Popular, Upcoming, Recent and Essentials by genre and decade), your own Lists, a release Calendar, Plex Watchlist sync, and one-click adding to Radarr and Sonarr. Everything is stored in /config and protected by its own sign-in. Open the WebUI and create your account on first run. Note: YAMZ is tested day to day with Plex. Jellyfin support should work but still needs more real-world testing.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Where YAMZ keeps its settings, lists, account and cache.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: Port for the YAMZ web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID YAMZ runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID YAMZ runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).

variables.name: Sign-in
variables.description: Keep 'on'. Choose 'none' ONLY if a reverse proxy in front of YAMZ already requires a login (Authelia, Authentik, etc.).

variables.name: Behind a reverse proxy
variables.description: Set to true when you reach YAMZ through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy). Enables secure cookies over https and correct client addresses for sign-in protection.

variables.name: Allow self-signed certificates
variables.description: Set to true if your Plex, Jellyfin, Radarr or Sonarr use https with a self-signed certificate.

variables.name: Base path
variables.description: Only needed if your reverse proxy serves YAMZ under a sub-folder (e.g. /yamz) WITHOUT stripping it. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: Initial username
variables.description: Optional. Creates this account on first start instead of the in-browser setup screen.

variables.name: Initial password
variables.description: Optional. Password for the initial account (at least 8 characters). You can remove it after the first start.
